# Paul's Notes
> Open educational reference for cancer research, biomedical statistics, computational biology, machine learning, R, Python, Rust and reproducible research. Current worked examples emphasize synthetic breast cancer data; the repository is not limited to breast cancer.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes
Human overview: https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/README.md
Machine navigation: https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/docs/machine-index.md

## Biomedical figure methodology and graph acceptance
- [Original figure-method alignment](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/03_learning/bio_stats/GRAPH_METHODS_ALIGNMENT.md): categorical bars, stem-and-leaf, box/mean and outlier fences, bootstrap estimator histograms, ROC and survival axes, source-scope and acceptance gates; retrieval key `pauls-notes.biomedical.graph-methods.v1`.
- [Executable graph module](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/06_RESOURCES/R/biostat_graphs.R) and [synthetic gallery](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/03_learning/bio_stats/GRAPH_METHODS_SYNTHETIC_GALLERY.Rmd): original synthetic figures, with machine-checkable graph statistics.

## Complete Eighth-edition biostatistics chapter coding contract
- [14-chapter biostatistics methodological contract](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/BIOSTAT_8E_COMPLETE_METHODOLOGY_CONTRACT.md): study-design-first scientific coding standards, counterexamples and verification gates. Retrieval key `pauls-notes.biostat8.complete-methodology.v1`.
- [Machine chapter coverage registry](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/biostat_8e_complete_chapter_alignment.csv): edition-specific pages, oncology chapter routes and evidence status. Use `scripts/check_biostat_8e_alignment.py` to validate structural links.

## Source-to-code first pass (eighth-edition methods)
- [First-pass source and code audit](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/BIOSTAT_ALIGNMENT_FIRST_PASS_AUDIT.md): verified quantile-convention mismatch, opt-in compatibility module, explicit tests and pending R execution; search key `pauls-notes.biomedical.biostat-alignment-first-pass.v1`.
- [Opt-in biostatistics descriptive contract](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/06_RESOURCES/R/biostat_descriptive_contract.R): type-2 vs type-7 quantiles with strict input checks.

## Breast cancer biostatistics roadmap
- [Methodology-aligned breast cancer textbook build plan](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/BIOSTAT_BREAST_CANCER_BIOSTATS_ALIGNMENT_ROADMAP.md): gated chapter and method alignment, original synthetic R examples, review requirements, BR-001–BR-010 tasks; retrieval key `pauls-notes.breast-cancer.biostat-methodology-roadmap.v1`.
- [Eighth-edition biostatistics coding companion](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/BIOSTAT_8E_SOURCE_VERIFIED_IMPLEMENTATION.md): source-aware statistical method cards and coding safeguards.

- [Book navigation](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/README.md): canonical reader entrypoint

- [CO-01 cancer biology](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-01-cancer-biology.md): draft first chapter
- [CO-02 clinical oncology data](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-02-clinical-oncology-data.md): draft clinical endpoints and data schema
- [CO-03 molecular foundations](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-03-molecular-foundations.md): draft omics and biomarker interpretation
- [CO-04 data literacy](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-04-data-literacy.md): draft observation grains and leakage controls
- [CO-05 mathematics](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/chapters/CO-05-essential-mathematics-i.md): ratios, oncology rates, unit conversion, log2 fold change and reproducible numerical examples

- [CO-06 validation record](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/CO-06-VALIDATION-2026-10-27.md): hash-matched Python replay; R/CI pending
- [Oncology teaching labs](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/examples/README.md): synthetic Python and R exercises
- [Readable source bibliography](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/SOURCES.md): verified reference links by subject
- [Section source register](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/source-registry.json): direct evidence URLs and claim scope
- [Section citation index](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/evidence/section-citations.json): H2/H3 source crosswalk

- [Book manifest](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/book-manifest.json): 60 chapter IDs, paths, statuses and prerequisites
- [Textbook roadmap](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/oncology/ROADMAP.md): architecture and milestones

## Canonical biomedical R coding template (read first for R analysis)
- [AI-ready biomedical R canonical example](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/BIOMEDICAL_R_CANONICAL_EXAMPLE.md): required example sheet for R/Rmd analysis structure, chunks, statistical evidence, plots, knitting and validation; retrieval key `pauls-notes.biomedical-r.canonical-example.v1`.
- [Full synthetic breast cancer study workbook](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/examples/SYNTHETIC_BREAST_CANCER_FULL_STUDY.Rmd): complete Rmd with 17 code chunks, research test-selection matrix and multi-method walkthrough. Retrieval key `pauls-notes.biomedical-r.full-study.v1`.
- [Biomedical implementation gates](https://github.com/pskeffington/pauls_notes/blob/main/02_biomedical_coding/IMPLEMENTATION_GATES.md): study/design/data/inference quality checks; read alongside the template.

## Agent and retrieval cautions
- Learning examples, test passes, published evidence and clinically validated results are distinct categories.
- Synthetic assay data must never be described as real TCGA or participant records.
- TCGA-BRCA is an example source under study, not a blanket admission or data-access authorization.
- Do not infer clinical accuracy, regulatory clearance, or safety from passing code tests.
- Verify primary references and the current gate ledger before stating implementation or scientific status.
- Never publish credentials, private records, or controlled-access participant data.
- Prefer stable repository paths and actual source text over summaries generated from the index.
